notes: Posted Date,Reference Number,Payee,Address,Amount. Newest first, MM/DD/YYYY, Payee and Address quoted (Address padded with spaces), Amount unquoted and signed from the cardholder's side: purchases negative, payments and refunds positive, no thousands separator. A payment's Reference Number is 23 spaces. File named <Month><Year>_<last four>.csv, CRLF. No balance in the file.
